  M5#2 guards a send that errors. The strand that note was written about is a
  swallowed Enter: send-keys returns 0 and the TUI never submits. cb-intake
  still has no equivalent of cb-send's verify ladder, so nothing confirms the
  coordinator received the line. The two strands observed 8/1 (one for 11h40m)
  are that shape and would still happen. I wrote the distinction into
  scheduled-tasks-log.md rather than let it read as done;
  cerebro-intake-strand-janitor stays live.

  So on arming: precondition 1 met, precondition 2 partially. Plus the
  intake-tick cron runs the same cb-intake --tick — arming without dropping its
  Part 1 doubles the claim rate against max-claim, which is the thing the TOCTOU
  gates were built to bound.

  hot.md's ★ now reads "arm the timer?" instead of "merge this," carrying both
  caveats.
